description: This file contains PHP unit tests for Facebook SDK components, specifically testing classes such as PHPSDKTestCase, TransientFacebook, FBPublic, and others related to Facebook API interactions, signed requests, URL generation, session management, and error handling.

classes.name: TransientFacebook
classes.description: A subclass of BaseFacebook implementing stub methods for persistent data handling used in tests.

classes.name: FBRecordURL
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook that records requested URLs for testing purposes.

classes.name: FBRecordMakeRequest
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook that records request calls made for testing.

classes.name: FBPublic
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook exposing public methods for encoding, decoding, and parsing signed requests.

classes.name: PersistentFBPublic
classes.description: A subclass of Facebook exposing methods to set, get, and clear persistent data, handle shared sessions, and retrieve URL info.

classes.name: FBCode
classes.description: A subclass of Facebook providing access to code and state tokens, with CSRF token establishment.

classes.name: FBAccessToken
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook for obtaining application access tokens.

classes.name: FBGetCurrentURLFacebook
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook to get the current URL.

classes.name: FBPublicCookie
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook to access signed request and metadata cookies.

classes.name: FBRewrite
classes.description: A subclass of Facebook with methods to uncache signed requests and simulate cache clearing.

classes.name: FBPublicGetAccessTokenFromCode
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook to get access tokens from codes.

classes.name: FBPublicState
classes.description: A subclass of TransientFacebook providing a fixed CSRF state for testing, with access to persistent data.

methods.name: publicGetSharedSessionID
methods.description: Returns the current shared session ID.

methods.name: publicSetPersistentData
methods.description: Sets persistent data for the session.

methods.name: publicGetPersistentData
methods.description: Retrieves persistent data for the session.

methods.name: publicClearPersistentData
methods.description: Clears persistent data for a given key.

methods.name: publicGetSharedSessionCookieName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cookie used for shared sessions.

methods.name: publicGetHttpHost
methods.description: Returns the HTTP host, considering forwarded headers if configured.

methods.name: publicGetHttpProtocol
methods.description: Returns the HTTP protocol (http or https), considering forwarded headers if configured.

methods.name: publicEndsWith
methods.description: Static method that checks if one string ends with another.

methods.name: publicIsAllowedDomain
methods.description: Static method to check if a domain is allowed within another domain.
